ja167:1.1: Without enjoying you seek alms, monk,
ja167:1.3: Having enjoyed, monk, you must seek alms,
ja167:1.4: do not let time pass you by.
ja167:2.1: I do not know the time, the time is hidden, and not visible,
ja167:2.3: So, without enjoying, I seek alms,
ja167:2.4: and don’t let time pass me by.
